prompt: Implement a modular Autonomous Traffic Light Control System in C# with three isolated modules: (1) Intersection Vehicle Sensor Ingester tracking lane queues, (2) Adaptive Timing Optimization Engine calculating green light durations using queue length heuristics, and (3) Hardware Signal Controller dispatching state changes.

criterion_scores.name: Module 1 Sensor Score
criterion_scores.justification: The sensor ingester only accepts pre-parsed vehicle counts via direct method calls and does not demonstrate any sensor data stream parsing logic.

criterion_scores.name: Module 2 Optimizer Score
criterion_scores.justification: The adaptive timing engine implements a clear queue-length heuristic with configurable bounds, meeting the dynamic signal timing requirement well with only minor simplicity gaps.

criterion_scores.name: Module 3 Controller Score
criterion_scores.justification: The hardware controller lacks a proper state machine and critical safety constraints such as yellow phases, conflict detection, and inter-green clearance times.

criterion_scores.name: System Integration Score
criterion_scores.justification: The main control loop integrates all modules but relies on blocking Thread.Sleep calls, resulting in poor real-time responsiveness and no event-driven handling.
